name: Beef Arrayes
steps: To a bowl, add the ground beef, chopped red onion, minced garlic, chopped corianter, and chopped jalapeno. Mix well and season with smoked paprika, cayenne, salt and pepper. Mix together until everything is evenly combined.
Open the pita bread and stuff it with the beef mixture.
Toast the stuffed pita bread in a pan or on a grill until golden brown on both sides, flip the pita filling side down and sear until the beef is fully cooked.
Chop the arrayes into halves and serve with your choice of sauce.
